failedPath.reuse: The prior initializer did not guarantee one reused Pool/Prisma pair across every warm Preview module evaluation.

proof: One hard reload recreated 10 idle runtime sessions.
A second isolated runtime could exceed the 15-client Supavisor session allowance.
The resulting application failure was EMAXCONNSESSION and displayed Dashboard unavailable.
No long-running query or checked-out transaction explained the persistent idle-session growth.
rootCause.classification: Serverless instances used a session pool and an implicit pg maximum of 10, mapping idle client sessions to persistent database backends.
